d: A billionaire is arrested for insider trading  "The Wolf of Wall Street" defrauds more than 1,500 clients.
A troubled Royal Canadian Mountie officer kills one of his own  the son of a Las Vegas judge robs $1.5 million from a casino.
A website posts explicit photos without the subjects' permission, then demands payment to remove them  El Chapo runs one of the world's largest drug-trafficking organizations.
The ruler of a drug cartel is responsible for mass murders and billions of dollars in drug trafficking  one of the longest-serving U.S. mayors is accused of running a criminal enterprise.
Actress Alexandra Ducsay is murdered in her home  the downfall of a prominent pro-independence leader in Taiwan.
An armored-car driver leads a team in a brazen heist, stealing more than $17 million from his employer  a Wall Street swindler destroys hundreds of lives.

Melanie McGuire made a living bringing life into the world as a fertility clinic nurse  the police accused her of shooting her husband, dismembering his body and disposing of it in suitcases dumped into the Chesapeake Bay.

Rutgers freshman Tyler Clementi and Dharun Ravi had only been roommates for a few weeks when Ravi decided to secretly film Tyler kissing another man  soon after, Clementi took his own life and Ravi faced surprising criminal charges.

st: Judgment of The Blue Moon Killer
d: The murders of Voncile Smith and her sons John and Richard set Pensacola, Florida on edge  the courts try to decide if this was an occult ritual or something much more basic: greed.
Lindsay Clancy's ex-mother-in-law testified on her behalf as the defense continued presenting evidence in the case involving the deaths of Lindsay's three children.
